q=quotes.copy()
q['Vendor']=q.vendor.map(names)
g=q.groupby('Vendor').agg(Lines=('rm_code','count'),Hist=('otif','count'),OTIF=('otif','mean'),Defect=('defect_rate','mean'),cO=('otif_claim_pct','mean'),cD=('defect_claim_pct','mean')).reset_index()
g['OTIF']=(g.OTIF*100).round(1);g['Defect']=(g.Defect*100).round(2)
g['Status']=['Watch' if h and o<95 else 'Good' if h else 'No history' for h,o in zip(g.Hist,g.OTIF.fillna(0))]
result=g.rename(columns={'Hist':'Lines w/ history','cO':'Claimed OTIF %','cD':'Claimed defect %'})
